audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 is given to Karma while its why says 'this is the level he closes the gap' and the content spike calls 6 'your worst window'; row 5 is given to Maokai while its why says 'it's a wash'.
audit.why: Two rows rendering the opposite of their own explanation. The packet chart independently reads Maokai at 4 and Skill at 5.
audit.corrected: Row 4 set to Maokai (3/10), row 5 to Skill (5/10) in both layers. Rows 0-3 and 6 already matched their whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was boilerplate; the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Nature's Grasp is 130/110/90s but the lane-deciding cooldown is Twisted Advance at 14/13/12/11/10s and 525 range, with Sapling Toss at 18/17/16/15/14s.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the Level 6 why and the Do's so the page finally has 'wait for X before you Y' advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance makes Maokai UNTARGETABLE for the duration of the dash, and Nature's Grasp creates advancing terrain that can cut off a dashless Karma's retreat. Neither is on the page.
audit.why: Kit flags: W untargetable + dash + hardCC; R terrain + hardCC at 3000 range. Burst timed onto his W cast is thrown away, and the ult is a retreat-cutter, not just a frontal root.
audit.corrected: Untargetability added to the Don'ts and the interactions row along with the R's retreat-cut.

audit.why: report[8].t already says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain', which is the right call against Sap Magic's attack-heal on a cooldown that shrinks every time he casts or is hit by a spell.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp is 130s, but Twisted Advance is the killer — 14s at rank 1, and he is untargetable mid-dash.

edits.before: Maokai spends Twisted Advance (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and only 525 range — his sapling is 18s, so step up in that gap.

edits.before: That’s Maokai’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: He goes untargetable mid-dash — never dump Mantra into the animation.

edits.before: Track Maokai’s Twisted Advance (Root): Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Twisted Advance makes him untargetable for the dash, so burst thrown at the cast is wasted — and Nature's Grasp walls your retreat, not just your face.
